text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe has embarked on a major project to improve the safety of its skies, through upgrading the Department of Civil Aviation's ability to supervise and monitor activities of the country's airlines and to ensure these are within acceptable international standards.
- The Zimbabwean capital Harare's city council has hired an Israeli company to help solve a sludge problem which has dogged the council for many years.
